bowl_config.storage_engine: Pebble per branch (常驻句柄池 + 12B BlobRef 索引)
bowl_config.blob_layout: blobs/<shard>/<blob_id>.blob (1 MiB 不可变块文件 + os.Remove 即时回收)
bowl_config.wal_sync_mode: pebble.NoSync + 1s 后台刷盘 (WALBytesPerSync=4 MiB, MemTableSize=16 MiB)
bowl_config.branch_lock: 拓扑生命周期 RLock + 按 inode 细粒度锁
bowl_config.parallel_blob_write: 1 MiB 块在 Inode 锁外并行落盘
bowl_config.atime_writeback: 内存延迟登记 + 1s 周期合并
